## Author checklist

- [ ] I checked the affected pages locally.
- [ ] For visual changes, I checked mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts using
      browser DevTools.
- [ ] I considered accessibility, including keyboard navigation, semantic HTML,
      contrast, and image alt text.
- [ ] For content changes, I verified spelling, grammar, links, and factual
      accuracy.
- [ ] I did not add secrets or other sensitive information.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency changes, if applicable.
